issue.title: `gh issue artifact` stack map
issue.body:
This is a "map" issue for the PR stack listed below. It should be closed when the final PR in the stack is merged.

This stack adds `gh issue artifact`, a command group in preview for the Markdown documents and links attached to an issue. It has six commands: `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `delete` and `download`. The stack also changes `--attach` in two ways that `create` needs, documents the commands in the `gh` agent skill, lets `edit` restore an earlier version, and adds artifact URLs.

```bash
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png
```

The design is in #14529, with one issue per command: #14523 (`list`), #14524 (`view`), #14525 (`create`), #14526 (`edit`), #14527 (`delete`) and #14528 (`download`). Each design issue has a screen for every scenario.

### The stack 🥞

Twelve pull requests, listed in reading order from the bottom. Each is based on the one below it. The total is about 3,200 lines of production code, a 440-line generated mock, 10,600 lines of tests and 110 lines of docs across 53 files, so most of the bulk is tests. Each code pull request has a video of the built `gh` in [bagtoad/issue-artifacts-demo](https://github.com/bagtoad/issue-artifacts-demo).
